title: ActiveRuns
description: The runs a worker is currently executing, returned by GET /runs/active: each still-running job by the launch identity captured at submit (a run gains a record only at completion). A job that has reached a terminal state is no longer active and drops out of this list (it is then listed by GET /runs as a produced run). The consoles seed their in-progress list from this so a run being watched survives a page reload.

runId.description: The live stream/job id (the same id POST /runs returned).

harnessSlug.description: The harness driving the run, as its slug string.

modelId.description: The opaque model id passed to the harness.

state.description: Always `running`: an entry exists in this list only while the run is in flight.
